/*
    Daily Authorization
    Inclusion of CUST_CIF_NBR (CIF) -> This will be used to JOIN in CI_DEMOGRAPHIC
*/
SELECT
    TXN.*
    ,CCD.CUST_CIF_NBR AS FCBSCIF
/*
    Remove the duplicates using ROW_NUMBER() window function
*/
FROM (
SELECT
    *
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RETR_KEY, MESSAGE_TYPE, TRAN_END_TIME, AUTH_NBR, CARD_NBR, INTERNAL_RESP_CODE, BANKNET_REF_NBR, RECV_ID 
        ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) DESC) RN
    FROM eds.CCD_CBCEXTXLGP_CI_20240618 TXN
    WHERE CAST(CAST(TRAN_DATE AS char(8)) AS date) >= '2024-04-01'
) TXN
/*
    Link all customers associated to the account of the transaction using AAS
    Fetch the ORGKEY in CUSTOMER_DIM
*/
INNER JOIN 
    (SELECT AS_OF_DATE, CUST_CIF_NBR, CRDACCT_NBR, CARD_NBR FROM eds.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT_CI_20240618 WHERE AS_OF_DATE <= '2024-04-01' GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE, CUST_CIF_NBR, CRDACCT_NBR, CARD_NBR) CCD
    ON TXN.CARD_ACCT_NBR = CCD.CRDACCT_NBR
    AND TXN.CARD_NBR = CCD.CARD_NBR
    AND CAST(CAST(TXN.TRAN_DATE AS char(8)) AS date) = CAST(CCD.AS_OF_DATE AS DATE)
WHERE RN = 1 AND CCD.CUST_CIF_NBR IS NOT NULL
